package repository

import "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"

type LessonRevisionRepository interface {
	GetGeneratedReceipt(ctx Context, key string) ([]domain.GeneratedLessonBinding, error)
	StoreGeneratedReceipt(ctx Context, key string, bindings []domain.GeneratedLessonBinding) ([]domain.GeneratedLessonBinding, error)
	GetRevision(ctx Context, id string) (*domain.LessonRevision, error)
	GetPolicy(ctx Context, lessonID string) ([]domain.LessonActivity, error)
	SetPolicy(ctx Context, lessonID string, activities []domain.LessonActivity) error
	StoreRevision(ctx Context, hash string, revision domain.LessonRevision) (*domain.LessonRevision, error)
}
